mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(r.started_at, '+00:00', #{offset}), '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, r.model_id AS model_id, COUNT(*) AS runs, COALESCE(SUM(r.tokens_in), 0) AS tokens_in, COALESCE(SUM(r.tokens_out), 0) AS tokens_out, COALESCE(SUM(r.cache_read_tokens), 0) AS cache_read_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(r.cache_write_tokens), 0) AS cache_write_tokens FROM runs r JOIN sessions s ON s.id = r.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.started_at >= #{from} GROUP BY day, r.model_id ORDER BY day

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(m.created_at, '+00:00', #{offset}), '%Y-%m-%d') AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS amount FROM messages m JOIN sessions s ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.role = 'tool' AND m.created_at >= #{from} AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.details, '$.toolName')) = 'kb_search' GROUP BY bucket

SELECT r.session_id AS session_id, s.title AS title, s.last_active_at AS last_active_at, r.model_id AS model_id, COUNT(*) AS runs, COALESCE(SUM(r.tokens_in), 0) AS tokens_in, COALESCE(SUM(r.tokens_out), 0) AS tokens_out, COALESCE(SUM(r.cache_read_tokens), 0) AS cache_read_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(r.cache_write_tokens), 0) AS cache_write_tokens FROM runs r JOIN sessions s ON s.id = r.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.started_at >= #{from} GROUP BY r.session_id, s.title, s.last_active_at, r.model_id

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(r.started_at, '+00:00', #{offset}), '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, r.model_id AS model_id, COUNT(*) AS runs, COALESCE(SUM(r.tokens_in), 0) AS tokens_in, COALESCE(SUM(r.tokens_out), 0) AS tokens_out, COALESCE(SUM(r.cache_read_tokens), 0) AS cache_read_tokens, COALESCE(SUM(r.cache_write_tokens), 0) AS cache_write_tokens FROM runs r JOIN sessions s ON s.id = r.session_id WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL AND r.started_at >= #{from} GROUP BY day, r.model_id ORDER BY day
SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(e.created_at, '+00:00', #{offset}), '%Y-%m-%d') AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS amount FROM exec_records e WHERE e.created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY bucket

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(c.created_at, '+00:00', #{offset}), '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS amount, COALESCE(SUM(c.tokens_before), 0) AS tokens_before, COALESCE(SUM(c.tokens_after), 0) AS tokens_after FROM compaction_events c WHERE c.created_at >= #{from} GROUP BY day ORDER BY day

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(m.created_at, '+00:00', #{offset}), '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS calls, SUM(CASE WHEN JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(m.details, '$.passages')) > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS hit_calls, COALESCE(SUM(JSON_LENGTH(JSON_EXTRACT(m.details, '$.passages'))), 0) AS passages, SUM(CASE WHEN JSON_EXTRACT(m.details, '$.passages') IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failed_calls FROM messages m JOIN sessions s ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.role = 'tool' AND m.created_at >= #{from} AND JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(m.details, '$.toolName')) = 'kb_search' GROUP BY day ORDER BY day
SELECT e.status AS status, COUNT(*) AS amount FROM exec_records e WHERE e.created_at >= #{from} AND e.status <> 'running' GROUP BY e.status
SELECT e.queue_ms AS queue_ms, e.duration_ms AS duration_ms FROM exec_records e WHERE e.created_at >= #{from} AND (e.queue_ms IS NOT NULL OR e.duration_ms IS NOT NULL)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM runs WHERE status = 'running'
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT r.session_id) FROM runs r JOIN sessions s ON s.id = r.session_id WHERE s.deleted_at IS NULL AND (r.started_at >= #{from} OR r.settled_at >= #{from})
